name: woltflow-token-reviewer
description: Chrome extension to review access and refresh tokens from Wolt.com

scripts.validate: echo 'Validating extension files...' && node -e "const manifest = require('./manifest.json'); console.log('✓ manifest.json is valid'); console.log('Extension name:', manifest.name); console.log('Version:', manifest.version);"
scripts.build: npm run create-icons && npm run validate
